items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: Interviewee discusses Sidney Bouchet's reputation and recordings ('Sidney Bouchet is the greatest... I think his playing on the uh the things he did for Panacier around 1938') but does not describe a personal interaction or professional collaboration.

ctx.x: the fastest uh articulation and tonguing of of uh any player I've heard. Oh another little story I'll

put on here since we don't have in our two lane uh archive either at uh once when Mary Carolli who liked uh Johnny Dodds very much as well as Sidney Bouchet and Jimmy Noon too she knew all three was clarinetists and um when she was visiting Jimmy Noon and he said you know uh Johnny Dodds thinks he's the greatest clarinetist in the world but uh you know he isn't he really isn't and uh so Mary said who is he thought maybe Jimmy would say well I am but yeah Sidney Bouchet. Yeah. No doubt about it all Sidney Bouchet…
he did for Panacier around 1938. Yeah those. Uh weary blues and Giada and those I think those are the best
